spec.description: Show the DSO health based on the SV status reports.

spec.title: CometBFT Height Lag
spec.description: Maximal minus minimal CometBFT height reported by the SV status reports seen from one SV's perspective

spec.expr: max by (namespace) (max by (report_publisher, namespace) (splice_sv_status_report_cometbft_height{namespace=~"$namespace", report_publisher=~"$sv_party", canton_version=~"$version"}) ) - min by (namespace) (max by (report_publisher, namespace) (splice_sv_status_report_cometbft_height{namespace=~"$namespace", report_publisher=~"$sv_party", canton_version=~"$version"}))

spec.title: Report Creation Time Lag
spec.description: Difference between the current time and the maximum report creation time, as ingested by any of the selected namespaces

spec.title: Status Report Creation Time Lag (current)
spec.description: Difference between the current time, and the creation time of the last status report (as ingested by any of the selected namespaces)

spec.title: Latest Open Mining Round Lag
spec.description: Should not go above 1 when all SVs are healthy, serves as a basic safeguard to see that the round structure makes progress from all SVs' point of view.

spec.expr: max by (namespace) (max by (report_publisher, namespace) (splice_sv_status_report_latest_open_round{namespace=~"$namespace", report_publisher=~"$sv_party", canton_version=~"$version"}) ) - min by (namespace) (max by (report_publisher, namespace) (splice_sv_status_report_latest_open_round{namespace=~"$namespace", report_publisher=~"$sv_party", canton_version=~"$version"}))

spec.title: Reporting Frequency
spec.description:
First, takes the maximum report number for each SV node (as seen by ANY of the selected namespaces).

Then, takes the 5m rate of change in that metric.

spec.title: Domain Time Progress
spec.description: How many seconds of progress on the reported participant domain time is observed every second.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, report_publisher, target_node) (rate(splice_sv_status_report_domain_time_us{namespace=~"$namespace", report_publisher=~"$sv_party", canton_version=~"$version"}[10m])) / 1000000

spec.title: SV Status Reports

spec.name: sv_party
spec.label: report publisher
spec.description: The SV whose node published the status report.
